title: Reminder
description: Cohesive reminder data stored in a companion text column next to a canonical native `date` column. Self-describing via the embedded `$schema` + `_type`. See notes/16.

relative.description: Offsets relative to the canonical date. Negative = before, positive = after. Compact form, e.g. "-15m", "-1d 2h". Units: w d h m s.

remindAt.description: Absolute reminder fire times, epoch milliseconds.

rrule.description: iCal RRULE subset describing the repeat, e.g. "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO".

exceptions.description: Excluded occurrence start times, epoch milliseconds.
